when_used: A chargee discharges a registered charge in relation to part of the charged property, releasing that part while the charge stands over the rest. The chargee is passed as the transferor, because it is the only party that signs, and the chargor as the transferee, and the chargee signs by its duly authorised attorneys.

detail_rows.label: Date of Registration of Charge(s) and entry Number
The Chargor: Give full name(s) and if corporate the registration number, if any
The Chargee: Give full name(s) and company’s registration number, if any
The Principal Amount Secured Under the Charge

body_text.text: The amounts secured under the Charge(s) being otherwise secured the Chargee HEREBY DISCHARGES the Charge(s) shown as entry number(s) {{charge_entry_numbers}} in the Encumbrances Section of the register of the above-mentioned Title wholly.

The Chargee HEREBY DISCHARGES the Charge(s) shown as entry number(s) {{charge_entry_numbers}} in the Encumbrances Section of the register in the above-mentioned Title in relation to {{property_released}}.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this partial discharge has been duly executed as a deed the day and year mentioned above.

execution.signed_label: SIGNED AND SEALED by the duly authorised attorney(ies) of the
execution.verification_heading: Verification of execution pursuant to Section 45 of the Land Registration Act
execution.signing_recital: under and by virtue of Powers of Attorney registered at the {{poa_lands_registry}} Lands registry as number {{poa_lands_no_1}} and {{poa_lands_no_2}} and at the registry of Documents at {{poa_docs_registry}} as Number {{poa_docs_no_1}} and {{poa_docs_no_2}} respectively
